name: Hyrule Castle B1 pit / key

points.label: f1_stair_approach
points.notes: North-wall stair at x≈1272; UP → F1 0x01

points.label: south_key_door
points.notes: North-ledge south key door. DOWN+LEFT from east lip (1320,3776); sub=4 spends 1 key. LEFT-only along the lip misses it.

points.label: key_ledge_drop
points.notes: DOWN through south_key_door lands here (lower floor, y=north_extent). keys=0 hp=20 $5D=6. Not a key-preserving drop. West to zelda_pit then south_door_approach → 0x82 ~(1190,4108) keys=0. South-first at x≈1224 hits the railing y=4032.

doors.label: north_to_0x01
doors.notes: Straight stairs (submodule 14). CastleB1Guard hold UP ~28f room-change, ~292f settle in 0x01 at (760,99). Stair column x≈1272; CastleB1Key x=1320 misses it.

doors.label: south_to_0x82
doors.notes: From CastleB1PitGuardCleared (1230,3989) walk SW; room-change ~y=4068. North ledge (CastleB1Guard) cannot reach this door (pit/rail). CastleB1Pit has 4 HP and dies. key_ledge_drop leftover (1272,3945) keys=0 also reaches it: west to zelda_pit then south; 0x82 ~(1190,4108).

notes: Pit/key chamber north of 0x82. CastleB1Key has small key already.
F1 stairs: north wall x≈1272 UP → room 0x01 (CastleB1Guard). Not at CastleB1Key x=1320.
North-ledge south key door ~(1287,3776): spend small key then DOWN → lower floor key_ledge_drop (1272,3945) keys=0. Grab/star/walk-off the railing do not drop. No keys>=1 drop found.
key_ledge_drop leftover walks west to zelda_pit then south_door_approach → 0x82 ~(1190,4108) isolated keys=0. South-first at x≈1224 hits the south railing y=4032.
